claims.head: NY Rangers’s chances off turnovers meet a soft spot
claims.body: NY Rangers ranks 10th of 32 for chances off turnovers (7.6% of its chances come right after winning the puck); New Jersey ranks 26th of 32 for avoiding breakdowns.

claims.body: NY Rangers ranks 3rd of 32 for physicality, toward the bruising end; New Jersey ranks 30th, toward the finesse end.
